description: This file contains mock class definitions for socket-related classes in the beerocks::net namespace, used for unit testing socket interactions by mocking methods such as connect, accept, send, and receive.

classes.name: SocketMock
classes.description: Mock class for the Socket interface, providing a mock method for obtaining the file descriptor.

classes.name: SocketConnectionMock
classes.description: Mock class for a socket connection, including mock methods for socket operations like receive and send.

classes.name: ServerSocketMock
classes.description: Mock class for server socket, including methods for accepting connections and mocking socket creation.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data into the provided buffer.

methods.name: receive_from
methods.description: Receives data from the socket, storing the sender's address.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data from the provided buffer.

methods.name: send_to
methods.description: Sends data to the specified address.

methods.name: std::unique_ptr<Socket::Connection> accept(Socket::Address & address)
methods.description: Accepts incoming socket connection, returns a unique pointer to a Socket::Connection.

methods.name: accept_proxy
methods.description: Proxy method for accepting socket connections, used internally for mocking due to limitations with Google Mock.
